"If we don't have the resolve to beat T.M. 
Opera O, there is no future for us." The 
Trainer and Admire Vega resolved to make 
their feelings clear.

It's not just her who has no future 
ahead—the same goes for T.M. Opera O. 
Unless they grow while competing with each 
other, they will surely be defeated by the 
generation above them.

And—a great awakening. What drove Meisho 
Doto was her indomitable fighting spirit, 
having never once given up on her own.

For herself, and for T.M. Opera O—Meisho 
Doto resolved to declare herself a true 
rival at the Japan Cup.
